faq.pageSubtitle: Everything you need to know about the USS Waiting Time app

items.question: Is the app free?
items.answer: Yes, completely free! All features including wait times, closure alerts, and show guides are available at no cost.

items.question: Which languages are supported?
items.answer: The app supports 6 languages: English, Bahasa Indonesia, Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese.

items.question: Do I need an internet connection?
items.answer: Yes, an internet connection is required as wait time data is updated in real time.

items.question: How often is the data updated?
items.answer: Ride wait times are refreshed about every 15 minutes while the park is open.

items.question: Why does the wait time differ from the display at the ride entrance?
items.answer: Wait times fluctuate constantly throughout the day. The app refreshes about every 15 minutes, so a small difference from the on-site display is normal — use it as a guide for planning your route.

brand.title: About USS Waiting Time
brand.description: We want to make every visit to Universal Studios Singapore more enjoyable. With live wait time data and closure alerts, your day at the park becomes smarter and more fun.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.content: This app provides ride wait times, typical wait trends, closure alerts, and show and dining guides for Universal Studios Singapore. We do not collect any personally identifiable information.

sections.heading: Advertising
sections.content: This app displays advertisements through Google AdMob. AdMob may use anonymous identifiers and device information to personalize ads.

sections.heading: Firebase Services
sections.content: This app uses Firebase (Google LLC) services. Firebase Analytics anonymously collects app usage data for improvement. Firebase Crashlytics collects crash reports to improve app stability.

sections.heading: Official Website Links
sections.content: Ride and venue pages link out to the official Universal Studios Singapore website for tickets and details. That website's own privacy policy applies once you leave the app.
